critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1191 lines - beyond the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into routers/modules (auth, payments, coupons, cron, erp resources).

apply_coupon increments coupon.uses at checkout creation time (not at successful payment). For paid (Stripe) flow, if the user abandons the session, the coupon quota is still consumed. Consider decrementing on cancel/expire or moving increment to webhook/status=paid.

PUT /api/admin/coupons/{code} does not validate percent_off range or duplicate discount presence like POST; a PUT with percent_off=200 or without any discount would still write. Recommend reusing the create validation.

cron _process_reminders: 'delta_days not in windows and not (delta_days < 0 and delta_days >= -1)' logic works but is subtle; consider explicit windows [7,3,1,0,-1] and clearer bucketing to avoid missing edge dates around timezones.
PLATFORM_ADMIN_EMAILS is read once at import time; changes to env require full restart (already fine for prod, just document).
